page_title: WER 0-5 BAY | Werder Bremen v Bayern Munich 21/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+1' The attendance for today's match is 42100.
90' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.

90' Crossbar! Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) picks up a precise pass and produces a bullet of a strike from distance that smashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
88' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes it short.

88' A snap shot by Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Michael Zetterer produces a good save to thwart him. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bayern Munich.
87' The substitution is prepared. Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Felix Agu.
84' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
82' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
79' Ole Werner has decided to substitute Amos Pieper and he is replaced by Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen).
78' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
77' Today's referee Bastian Dankert rightly decides to book Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) for his harsh tackle.
76' A substitution has been made. Harry Kane is replaced by Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich).
75' Total attempts – 0:21.

74' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
72' Michael Zetterer makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) after a cross from the side.
71' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) sends a cross into the box, but Sven Ulreich comes off his line to gather the ball.
70' Substitution. Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) has come on for Michael Olise.
70' Vincent Kompany has decided to make a change. Joao Palhinha (Bayern Munich) replaces Aleksandar Pavlovic.
68' The foul by Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Bastian Dankert.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jens Stage departs the field of play to be replaced by Skelly Alvero (Werder Bremen).

65' 0 - 5 Harry Kane produces a sweet pass and picks out Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the bottom right corner and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 0:5!
60' 0 - 4 Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball into the top left corner in trademark fashion.

57' 0 - 3 GOAL! Superb work from Michael Olise, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), who beats Michael Zetterer with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 0:3.
57' Vincent Kompany has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) replacing Konrad Laimer.
57' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Kingsley Coman as he is replaced by Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich).
56' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) produces a long-range strike, but he only hits one of his own teammates standing in its way.
54' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Werder Bremen.

54' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes behind for a corner. Werder Bremen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
52' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
49' Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Ole Werner gives a chance to Keke Topp and Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is off.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Marco Grull comes off for Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Surely that's handball by one of the Werder Bremen players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
41' The linesman signals that Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
39' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) tries to find Konrad Laimer, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
39' The ball is cleared after Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
38' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) receives a yellow card!
35' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
32' 0 - 2 Goal - 0:2! Michael Olise laid the ball off to Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich), who slots it into the back of the net from close range, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
29' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.

28' Alphonso Davies plays a short pass through to Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) inside the box, but he scuffs his effort well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
23' 0 - 1 Goal! Harry Kane provides Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
23' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
22' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
17' Nightmare of a shot. Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) is first to a rebound inside the 6-yard box but his shot goes high and wide of the goal.

16' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) attempts to score from a mid-range free kick, but he curls his effort a few inches over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
15' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for a foul. Bayern Munich earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
13' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
13' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Corner kick. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity.
10' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
10' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

10' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Bayern Munich win a corner.

8' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) latches onto a pass and lets fly at goal from the edge of the box. The shot beats the keeper but smashes against the crossbar. Good effort! The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
6' Bayern Munich seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
5' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
3' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
1' The match has just started.
Werder Bremen will kick the game off.
Bastian Dankert will referee today's match.
